info.title: Hawlader Battery ERP — Critical Command Design
info.description: Phase 1 design only; no server implemented. Partial API coverage: critical posting commands. Full endpoint catalog: ../API.md. All stock/money commands use PostgreSQL transactions, business source uniqueness and idempotency. API DTOs never expose costs/profit to unauthorized users.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-hb_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque secure HttpOnly session; backend RBAC and CSRF required.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Actor/operation-scoped UUID; identical canonical payload replays committed response. A new key cannot repost a finalized source.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Session-bound token from CSRF bootstrap. Unsafe browser requests also require allowed Origin.

Money.description: BDT decimal string; supplied payments must be strictly positive, checked server-side.

Quantity.description: Strictly positive base-unit quantity. Batteries require an integer; validated against product.

serialNumber.description: Manufacturer serial; required for SERIAL/BOTH products.

BatteryIdentity.description: Server enforces product-specific SERIAL, PRODUCTION_DATE or BOTH requirements. Production date is not unique.

ConfirmSale.description: Posts stored draft; empty payments permits due sale. All stock/pricing/discount/warranty checks repeat inside the transaction.

warrantyOverrideReason.description: Requires warranty.override, never automatically grants eligibility.

ReceiveReplacements.description: Receive listed claims only. New units begin unavailable pending inspection; old identity remains intact. Customer is derived from claim.

acknowledgementReference.description: Required for customer return or consent-based disposal.

ResolveRejection.description: Validate source/ownership, actual custody, customer consent, approvals, and financial write-off treatment; cannot release customer-owned stock for sale.

PaymentAllocation.description: Exactly one target; direction/party must agree. Locks target and validates remaining due.

RecordPayment.description: Exactly one party: customer incoming or supplier outgoing. Non-advance allocations equal total; advances may leave unapplied balance. Outgoing requires finance.write.
